scope: AACR 2026 (San Diego, Apr 17-22) — Sunday Apr 19 presenters + Monday Apr 20 presenters only. AAN and Tuesday late-breakers excluded.
scoring_stack: Conference Overlay v1.0 (AACR ELITE +20%, type weight, multi bonus)
Smart Money Overlay v1.0 (13F + insider + analyst + structural)
HINT Q2 v1.0 (ADVISORY ONLY, drug-molecule small-molecule prior)
boost_cap_rule: Cross-Engine Scorecard v1.0 — cap total multiplicative boost at +25%.
cardinal_rule: The runup IS the trade. Exit before or at the close of data release day.
ranking_methodology: Tier 1 = real clinical data with SOC-beating delta presented Sun or Mon. Tier 2 = Phase 2b / Phase 3 subgroup or immune-response readouts Mon. Tier 3 = late-breaker / preclinical with strong mechanism. HINT skipped as scorable=False for ADC / biologic / oligonucleotide / cell therapy / DARPin / BDC / oncolytic / CAR-T per HINT OOD rules.

ranked_top_10.name: Adagene
ranked_top_10.monday_driver: Overnight digestion of two Sun posters with real SOC-beating ORR/PFS data

data_disclosed.HCC_triplet: Muzastotug + atezolizumab + bevacizumab in 1L HCC — ORR 66.7% vs SOC control 32.5%; mPFS 8.2 mo vs 5.5 mo
data_disclosed.MSS_CRC: ORR 25% (10 mg/kg) and 40% (15 mg/kg) monotherapy-refractory MSS mCRC

ranked_top_10.why_it_explodes_monday: The ONLY nano/small cap in the Sunday slate with clinical data that BEATS a well-defined SOC control arm across TWO indications. 2x ORR uplift in 1L HCC + MSS CRC response at a disease state where checkpoint monotherapy is effectively 0%. This is the rare bioscience signal that trading desks will open Monday leaning into.
ranked_top_10.mechanism: Masked anti-CTLA-4 that cleaves only in the tumor microenvironment — preserves peripheral T-reg function (lower colitis/hypophysitis) while delivering full CTLA-4 blockade intratumorally. Validated mechanism (ipilimumab is SOC in mela/RCC) with de-risked PK/PD.
ranked_top_10.precedent: BMS relatlimab (anti-LAG3) + nivo in mela showed +4.5 pp ORR vs nivo alone was worth $3B in RELATIVE valuation. Muzastotug is delivering +34 pp vs SOC in HCC — order of magnitude larger.
ranked_top_10.competitive_context: Anti-CTLA-4 masked prodrug space: ONC-392 (Shattuck Labs), AGEN1181 (Agenus botensilimab). Muzastotug has the cleanest safety delta and highest ORR uplift presented to date.
ranked_top_10.red_flags: Small n per cohort. China-origin sponsor — some desks apply a discount. Need full swimmer plots to confirm durability.
ranked_top_10.hint_reason: biologic — masked IgG prodrug, MPNN cannot embed
ranked_top_10.action: STRONG_BUY at Monday open, scale in first 30 min
ranked_top_10.exit_rule: Exit before ESMO readout window or at post_1d close if ODIN-style gap > 15%

ranked_top_10.name: Bicycle Therapeutics
ranked_top_10.presentation_day: Sun Apr 19 oral + Mon Apr 20 clinical poster
ranked_top_10.monday_driver: Monday 9am-12pm PT CT063 poster WITH Phase 1/2 clinical data in advanced solid tumors — timed exactly for market open

data_disclosed.Sun_oral: BT5528 HNSCC CDX preclinical mechanistic package (4:05-4:20pm)
data_disclosed.Mon_clinical: CT063 — BT5528 + nivo Phase 1/2 clinical data in advanced solid tumors; expanded safety and ORR update

ranked_top_10.why_it_explodes_monday: CT063 is the freshest Monday clinical poster in the small-cap universe and drops exactly at the NYSE open window. Bicycle platform has produced three consecutive clean readouts (BT8009 UC, BT7480, BT5528). Any ORR north of ~20% in a ph1/2 advanced solid tumor basket + nivo combo clears the bar.
ranked_top_10.mechanism: Bicycle peptide-drug conjugates — proprietary constrained peptides deliver cytotoxic payload. EphA2 expressed in HNSCC, UC, gastric. Small molecule–like PK with biologic-like target affinity.
ranked_top_10.precedent: BT8009 (zelenectide pevedotin) in Nectin-4+ UC 52% ORR post-EV — validated the BDC platform.
ranked_top_10.competitive_context: EphA2 ADC space: MEDI-547 (discontinued — toxicity), HKT-288 (preclinical). BCYC's BDC format has far better therapeutic index vs legacy mAb-based ADCs.
ranked_top_10.red_flags: Phase 1/2 with modest n. Nivo combo can inflate apparent ORR. Stock already up on BT8009 — some of the AACR premium pre-priced.
ranked_top_10.hint_reason: BDC — non-small-molecule payload conjugate, MPNN cannot embed
ranked_top_10.action: BUY at open, sized for CT063 reaction window
ranked_top_10.exit_rule: Exit by Mon close. CT063 is the event — no reason to hold into Tuesday's clinical trials plenary noise.

ranked_top_10.name: Oncolytics Biotech
ranked_top_10.monday_driver: Sunday evening digestion of GOBLET mPDAC biomarker data + AWARE-1 cold-to-hot tumor data

data_disclosed.GOBLET_mPDAC: Cohort 1 biomarker: immune activation signatures correlate with mPFS 7.5 mo (biomarker+) vs 5.6 mo (biomarker-)
data_disclosed.AWARE_1_breast: Cold → hot tumor conversion with CD8+ TIL infiltration post-pelareorep

ranked_top_10.why_it_explodes_monday: Pancreatic cancer remains the highest unmet-need tumor. A 2-month mPFS delta in 1L mPDAC linked to a tractable biomarker would be one of the top signals of AACR Sunday. ONCY is a chronic underperformer — if the biomarker story lands, the short squeeze potential is disproportionate.
ranked_top_10.mechanism: Oncolytic reovirus — selectively replicates in RAS-activated cells, lyses tumor, releases TAA, primes T-cell response. Converts cold tumor to hot phenotype pre-checkpoint.
ranked_top_10.precedent: T-VEC (Amgen) for melanoma — validated oncolytic viral mechanism. REOLYSIN prior readouts in breast showed immune activation signal.
ranked_top_10.competitive_context: mPDAC 1L is brutal — FOLFIRINOX, gem/nab-pac SOC, very few wins post-Olaparib POLO. Any mPFS extension is investable.
ranked_top_10.red_flags: ONCY has cried wolf before. Biomarker-positive subgroup selection is methodology-sensitive. Nano-cap liquidity risk on any pullback.
ranked_top_10.hint_reason: oncolytic virus — not a small molecule, MPNN cannot embed
ranked_top_10.exit_rule: Exit into Monday rip or by Tue morning. Do not hold past the week.

ranked_top_10.name: Zentalis Pharmaceuticals
ranked_top_10.monday_driver: Mon 2-5pm PT Poster 2012 — azenosertib preclinical package including 42-99% TGI and 7/8 CR with azenosertib + enfortumab vedotin in ADC-resistant PDX models

data_disclosed.azenosertib_EV_combo: 7/8 complete responses in enfortumab-vedotin-resistant PDX models
data_disclosed.mono_TGI: 42-99% tumor growth inhibition across multiple models

ranked_top_10.why_it_explodes_monday: ADC resistance is the #1 thesis buyer in oncology right now. If WEE1 + EV resensitizes, ZNTL gets pulled into the 'ADC resistance platform' narrative. Already bruised stock + Tier-1 preclinical data = coiled spring.
ranked_top_10.mechanism: WEE1 kinase inhibitor — forces cells through G2/M checkpoint with unrepaired DNA damage. ADC payload pre-damages DNA; WEE1 inhibitor converts repair-response cells into apoptosis.
ranked_top_10.precedent: Adavosertib (AstraZeneca WEE1) abandoned due to safety; azenosertib has cleaner tolerability profile and has shown monotherapy activity in uterine serous carcinoma.
ranked_top_10.competitive_context: WEE1 class: AstraZeneca adavosertib (discontinued), Debio 0123. ZNTL has the only asset with active Ph2 programs in multiple tumor types.
ranked_top_10.red_flags: Preclinical only. History of safety-driven restarts. Small cap but not nano — moves are smaller as % of mcap.
ranked_top_10.hint_score_note: Could be re-scored via HINT for small-molecule WEE1 mechanism. Advisory only.
ranked_top_10.action: BUY SMALL at open, scale if poster session produces press release
ranked_top_10.exit_rule: Exit by Mon close. Preclinical data doesn't carry overnight.

ranked_top_10.name: Cardiff Oncology
ranked_top_10.monday_driver: Sun 2-5pm poster — onvansertib + T-DXd 62% CR in HER2-low PDX + CDK4/6i-resistant synergy + fulvestrant-resistant lines. Complements Jan 2026 72.2% ORR mCRC Phase 2 clinical data.
ranked_top_10.asset: Onvansertib (PLK1 inhibitor) — multiple ADC and endocrine combos

data_disclosed.AACR_preclinical: 62% CR with onva + T-DXd in HER2-low breast PDX; synergy in CDK4/6i-resistant and fulvestrant-resistant HR+ breast lines
data_disclosed.prior_clinical: Jan 2026 CRDF-004 Phase 2 interim: 72.2% ORR at 30 mg onva + FOLFIRI + bev in 1L KRAS-mutant mCRC vs 43% historical SOC

ranked_top_10.why_it_explodes_monday: CRDF is the purest mechanistic pair-trade of AACR Sunday. PLK1 inhibition gives oncologists a new lever for HER2-low breast — a tumor class worth $5B+/yr. Combined with the already-published 72% Phase 2 ORR signal in mCRC, Monday open should see the thesis reinforcement bid.
ranked_top_10.mechanism: PLK1 = polo-like kinase 1, controls mitotic entry. Inhibition arrests cells at G2/M, synergizes with DNA-damaging and endocrine agents. Onva is orally bioavailable, small molecule, clean PK.
ranked_top_10.precedent: Rigosertib (PLK1/PI3K inhibitor) showed mechanistic activity but failed on tolerability. Onva has a much cleaner safety window.
ranked_top_10.competitive_context: PLK1 space: onvansertib is the only clinical-stage selective PLK1 in oncology. No crowded field — CRDF has a defensible moat if Phase 2 confirms.
ranked_top_10.red_flags: Already up 40% YTD on Jan 2026 data. Preclinical add at AACR may be priced in. Nano-cap liquidity on any reversal.
ranked_top_10.hint_note: HINT Q2 scored onva mCRC 0.6733 NEUT+ — corroborative of bullish thesis
ranked_top_10.action: HOLD existing / ADD on weakness at open
ranked_top_10.exit_rule: Core position through Q2 2026 CRDF-004 data. Trim 50% if Monday gap > 10%.

ranked_top_10.name: Greenwich LifeSciences
ranked_top_10.monday_driver: Mon 2-5pm Section 52 Abstract CT138 — 'first FLAMINGO-01 poster with statistically significant immune response data'

data_disclosed.FLAMINGO_01_CT138: Statistically significant DTH (delayed-type hypersensitivity) immune response data in Phase 3 adjuvant HER2+ breast patients

ranked_top_10.why_it_explodes_monday: FLAMINGO-01 is a Phase 3 adjuvant breast cancer trial — any statistically significant immune response in the registration study is investable. GLSI has traded in a tight range for 6 months; catalyst volatility tends to be explosive on small caps that have compressed.
ranked_top_10.mechanism: GP2 = HER2-derived 9-amino-acid peptide. Primes CD8+ T cells to HER2+ residual disease post-trastuzumab. Immune response marker = DTH.
ranked_top_10.precedent: NeuVax (nelipepimut-S) from GALENA — failed Phase 3 (PRESENT trial). GLSI has tighter patient selection and a different immune readout.
ranked_top_10.competitive_context: HER2+ adjuvant vaccine space: thin. Most focus on ADC (T-DXd, Enhertu). Vaccine approach is a differentiated bet.
ranked_top_10.red_flags: Surrogate endpoint (DTH) — not overall survival. Phase 3 adjuvant trials historically underwhelm on vaccines. Prior FLAMINGO interim was non-impressive.
ranked_top_10.hint_reason: peptide vaccine — MPNN cannot embed full peptide
ranked_top_10.exit_rule: Exit Mon close. DTH data without PFS/OS is not thesis-building.

ranked_top_10.name: BriaCell Therapeutics
ranked_top_10.monday_driver: Mon 2-5pm Poster CT137 — Phase 3 Bria-IMT QOL outcomes maintained health + favorable safety in metastatic breast cancer

data_disclosed.CT137_Ph3: QOL maintained + safety profile favorable in Phase 3 metastatic breast; regulatory pathway update

ranked_top_10.why_it_explodes_monday: Phase 3 poster in a well-known underowned nano. QOL data doesn't move stocks alone, but combined with safety and enrollment updates, a positive reception can trigger 30%+ squeezes on a nano.
ranked_top_10.mechanism: Whole-cell allogeneic immunotherapy — irradiated breast cancer cell line expressing GM-CSF. Primes immune response to shared breast tumor antigens.
ranked_top_10.precedent: GVAX (whole-cell pancreatic) — mixed results. Bria-IMT has cleaner patient selection (heavily pre-treated).
ranked_top_10.competitive_context: Cellular immunotherapy space for mBC: thin. Most focus on T-DXd, sacituzumab, endocrine combos.
ranked_top_10.red_flags: Whole-cell immunotherapy historically disappoints in pivotal trials. QOL endpoint is soft. Very small company — execution risk.
ranked_top_10.hint_reason: whole-cell allogeneic — cell therapy, not scorable
ranked_top_10.exit_rule: Exit Mon close regardless of direction.

ranked_top_10.name: Theriva Biologics
ranked_top_10.monday_driver: Mon Poster CT162 — Phase 2b VIRAGE subgroup analyses including liver mets

data_disclosed.VIRAGE_CT162: Subgroup efficacy in Phase 2b VCN-01 + chemotherapy in mPDAC, including liver metastasis subgroup

ranked_top_10.why_it_explodes_monday: PDAC + oncolytic virus = maximum high-risk/high-reward setup. A positive subgroup readout — especially in liver mets where standard chemo fails fastest — is nano-cap catalyst gold.
ranked_top_10.mechanism: VCN-01 = conditionally replicative adenovirus, intravenously administered. Selectively infects and lyses tumor cells with high pRB levels. Releases hyaluronidase to disrupt tumor stroma.
ranked_top_10.precedent: T-VEC (Amgen) intralesional validated oncolytic mechanism. VCN-01 is IV — much larger TAM if safe.
ranked_top_10.competitive_context: IV oncolytic virus space: CG Oncology (CG0070 bladder), Replimune (RP1 mela). TOVX is the only IV oncolytic in PDAC.
ranked_top_10.red_flags: Subgroup analyses are data dredging risk. Nano liquidity. VCN-01 history of interim misses.

ranked_top_10.name: Acrivon Therapeutics
ranked_top_10.presentation_day: Sun Apr 19 poster + Mon Apr 20 late-breakers
ranked_top_10.monday_driver: Monday late-breaker abstracts LB152 + 3789 — ACR-368 + ACR-2316 combination synergy data

data_disclosed.LB152_LB3789: Preclinical combination synergy + ACR-2316 PKMYT1 monotherapy activity

ranked_top_10.why_it_explodes_monday: Late-breaker prestige + dual DNA-damage-response mechanism + underfollowed smaller company = classic AACR nano squeeze setup.
ranked_top_10.mechanism: ACR-368 inhibits CHK1/2 (checkpoint kinases, gatekeepers of G2/M). ACR-2316 inhibits WEE1/PKMYT1 (redundant G2/M checkpoint). Combination exhausts DNA-damage checkpoint redundancy.
ranked_top_10.precedent: Prexasertib (Lilly CHK1) discontinued; azenosertib (ZNTL WEE1) Ph2. Combination of both is novel.
ranked_top_10.competitive_context: CHK1 space: Acrivon + legacy Lilly/Array. WEE1 space: ZNTL + AstraZeneca. Nobody else is doing the combo.
ranked_top_10.red_flags: Preclinical data at late-breaker tier. Small company with history of erratic trading. Combination toxicity profile unknown.
ranked_top_10.hint_score_note: Could be re-scored — small-molecule kinase inhibitors. Advisory.
ranked_top_10.exit_rule: Exit Mon close or Tue open before Tuesday plenary noise.

ranked_top_10.name: Molecular Partners
ranked_top_10.monday_driver: Mon Apr 20 9am-12pm PT Poster 1624 — MP0632 logic-gated Switch-DARPin T cell engager preclinical package
ranked_top_10.asset: MP0632 (MSLN/EpCAM dual-antigen DARPin T cell engager)

data_disclosed.MP0632_Poster_1624: Logic-gated DARPin — only activates when BOTH MSLN and EpCAM are expressed on a tumor cell. Selectively spares normal tissue expressing either antigen alone.

ranked_top_10.why_it_explodes_monday: Dual-antigen logic gating is one of the hottest preclinical themes in oncology. MOLN has been a darling then forgotten; a compelling Monday poster can resurrect the conviction.
ranked_top_10.mechanism: DARPin scaffold + logic gate: CD3-binding arm stays cryptic until both tumor-associated antigens engage simultaneously. Dramatically narrows on-target off-tumor toxicity.
ranked_top_10.precedent: Roche RG7828 (dual-antigen CEA/CD3) — validated concept. MOLN has proprietary Switch-DARPin IP.
ranked_top_10.competitive_context: Dual-antigen TCE space: Janux Therapeutics, Harpoon (discontinued), CytomX (Probodies). MOLN's Switch-DARPin is arguably the cleanest platform.
ranked_top_10.red_flags: Preclinical only. DARPin platform has yet to produce a commercial drug. Swiss-origin can be underowned in US small-cap flow.
ranked_top_10.hint_reason: DARPin — engineered binding protein, MPNN cannot embed
ranked_top_10.action: SMALL BUY at open — thesis-add for platform
ranked_top_10.exit_rule: Exit Mon close. Preclinical DARPin data doesn't build a multi-day trend.
